description.en: The characteristic coloring of the exterior with its complex panel lines is reproduced with molding colors and seals!

description.en: The intricate panel lines all over the body are reproduced with Tetron Seal, which can be applied flexibly.

description.ja: アクションベース２（別売）に対応し、躍動感あるディスプレイが可能。
description.en: Compatible with Action Base 2 (sold separately), allowing for dynamic displays.
